name.en-US: Seasonal Sermons II: Epiphany to the Dedication of a Church (Mount Melleray)
name.pt-BR: Sermões do tempo litúrgico II: da Epifania à Dedicação de uma igreja (Mount Melleray)

description.en-US: Sermons of Bernard for Epiphany, Septuagesima, Lent, Palm Sunday, Easter, the Ascension, Pentecost, the Sundays after Pentecost and the Dedication of a Church, with the two sermons on St. Malachy and two epistles to Malachy, in the English of a priest of Mount Melleray (Dublin, 1923), volume two of his Sermons for the Seasons and Principal Festivals of the Year.
description.pt-BR: Sermões de São Bernardo na tradução inglesa de um sacerdote de Mount Melleray (Dublin).

en-US.translator: A priest of Mount Melleray (Ailbe Luddy)

sources.edition: St. Bernard's Sermons for the Seasons and Principal Festivals of the Year, translated from the original Latin by a Priest of Mount Melleray, vol. 2 (Dublin: Browne and Nolan, 1923).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR cleaned by script, not proofread; the running heads are stripped by pattern and the translator's occasional footnotes are not kept. The translator (a priest of Mount Melleray, Ailbe Luddy) divides and orders the sermons by the liturgical calendar as listed here, which differs from the Latin book.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1923, before 1931: public domain in the US.
